description: This file contains the implementation of the MTAHAL class, which provides an interface for managing various aspects of the Multi-Tenant Access (MTA) hardware component. It includes functions for initialization, configuration retrieval, status checks, logging, device reset, provisioning, and callback registration, among others. The functions interact with lower-level system calls (prefixed with ssp_MTAHAL_) to perform hardware or system-level operations and return results in JSON format for external use.

classes.name: MTAHAL
classes.description: The MTAHAL class provides a set of static and instance methods for managing the Multi-Tenant Access hardware. It includes initialization, configuration, status retrieval, logging, reset, provisioning, and callback registration functionalities.
